maria: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone stitch: Search Relevance + Model Routing. Concise answers please: what shipped, what's slipped, who owns next steps, and any blockers/deps before EOW? I'm circling owners for handoff.

eli: Model Routing slipped — quant perf regress on long-context, working on patch. ETA EOD Wed. Owner: eli. Blocker: need nightly GPU tests to run on the dedicated pool (depends on infra change).
anuj: infra note — dedicated pool autoscaler change is scheduled Thu morning (maintenance window). If you need tests earlier I can provision a short-lived pool but cost will be charged to eng-ops.
lina: FYI there's a DB migration on Thu affecting model-meta-service 02:00-04:00 UTC. Avoid canaries during that window.
maria: OK — eli, can you confirm whether the patch needs the autoscaler change or just the test pool? If autoscaler required, we might delay canary until after maintenance.
eli: Patch needs autoscaler flags flipped, so depends on anuj's change. If anuj can do a quick manual flip for our tests, we can keep timeline; otherwise EOW slip.
anuj: I can flip flags early Wed 21:00 UTC for a 2hr window. Who will run the GPU tests? @eli or @shawn?
eli: I'll run tests and post results in thread. Thanks.
shawn: I'll take the EU canary after tests pass. Ping me with the run id. PR for canary config: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/824
